text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I are walking<n>past the train
station when she<n>suddenly remembers something
and<n>stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember that cafe we tried<n>going to the
other day?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm still baffled as to why it was<n>closed so
early. Do you mind if we go<n>back and check it out?

And with that request, we make our<n>way to the cafe
together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It closes at 8 p.m., so it should still be<n>open...

We're almost at the cafe when we<n>see someone
who appears to be the<n>owner pulling down the
shutters.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It seems like it. I wonder why. I'll go<n>ask.
I follow her as she approaches the<n>owner.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Have your store hours<n>changed
recently? I thought you were<n>supposed to be open
for a while yet.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Terribly sorry about that, but yes,<n>we've been
closing a little early<n>lately.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
It just doesn't make sense to stay<n>open when we
get no customers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You don't?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
No... Not since that new place down<n>the street run
by some famous<n>celebrity barista opened up.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: Business dried up as soon as thatplace started. Honestly, we mighthave to close up shop permanentlysoon.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That can't be...

There's no question as to what cafe<n>that must be.
No doubt, it's the one I<n>visited with Biwa Hayahide
the other<n>day.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Up until recently, we managed to<n>scrape by
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
We've come up with seasonal menu<n>items and
listened to the requests of<n>our regulars...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
But no matter what we do, it's not<n>enough to
compete against a famous<n>barista.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
It makes sense. When someone like<n>that, with both
skills and fame, opens<n>a shop down the street,
there's not<n>much a small cafe like us can do.

Biwa Hayahide's expression clouds<n>as she mulls
over the matter.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I understand how you feel. However...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What I love most about your cafe is<n>how cozy its
atmosphere is and what<n>a wonderful person you
are.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And those things are all a result of<n>how much effort
you've put into<n>making your customers happy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've accomplished so much<n>already. Why don't
you try just a<n>little harder and see what comes of
it?

Her impassioned speech is inspiring. I<n>feel as
though it's enough to fire<n>anyone up. However...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your kind words mean a<n>great deal to
me.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
But running a business isn't easy.<n>Sometimes, you
just have to cut your<n>losses.

Unfortunately, Biwa Hayahide's<n>encouragement
isn't enough to spur<n>the owner into further action.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I suppose life is difficult no matter<n>what one
pursues.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I only wish there was something I<n>could do to help...

Pursuing a dream is tough. She<n>knows that better
than anyone.
choice_data_list: If only the cafe could do something to set it apart...
Maybe we can help promote the cafe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Set it apart... Yes, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I go there all the time! I would know<n>better than
anyone how it can best<n>stand out!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This information might be just what<n>we need to
change the owner's<n>mind!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me come up with<n>something I
can do!

I have high hopes that Biwa<n>Hayahide can get
through to the<n>owner as we walk home together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I guess, realistically speaking, that's<n>about all we
can do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But simply promoting the cafe<n>probably won't yield
any significant<n>results...
choice_data_list: If only we had something to work with...
If only we had something to work with...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But of course! If there's nothing to<n>work with yet,
we can start from<n>scratch and try to catch people's
attention with a new idea!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll start putting together everything<n>we need once I
get back!
choice_data_list: Let me know if I can help.
Let me know if I can help.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I'm going to<n>make sure that
cafe stays in<n>business!

With that strong declaration, it's clear<n>that Biwa
Hayahide is filled with<n>determination.
